register_model: register a new model class to the fairchem registry with a unique name key
register_task: register a new task class to the fairchem registry with a unique name key
register_dataset: register a new dataset class to the fairchem registry with a unique name key
register_loss: register a new loss class inheriting nn.Module to the fairchem registry with a name
get_model_class: get a registered model class from the fairchem registry by its name or full import path
